insight.headline: Shop SDK lead capture now supports Rich Authorization Requests
insight.what_changed: You can now request the specific profile data your app needs during Shop SDK lead capture, including details that aren't saved on the user's Shop profile. Use Rich Authorization Requests (RAR) to select which fields are required and which ones users can skip. Existing integrations don't need changes to continue working; RAR is opt-in.
